dedupe_keys.name: simulation of the dynamics of a monopole structure subjected to non stationary stochastic downburst wind loads using the wavelet galerkin approach

description: Simulation of the dynamics of a monopole structure subjected to non-stationary, stochastic downburst wind loads using the Wavelet-Galerkin approach is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Luca Caracoglia, Northeastern University (northeastern.edu). Version 1.0 of the WGplate program is a MATLAB®-based graphical user interface (GUI) that demonstrates the application of the Wavelet-Galerkin approach to approximately solve the coupled equations of motions that govern the structural dynamics of a monopole plate structure subjected to non-stationary, stochastic downburst wind loads. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-a8nq-g348. Keywords: Wavelet-Galerkin, Thunderstorm Downburst, Transient Simulation. Published 2019-01-29. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated in the DesignSafe listing (publication licences offered are CC BY 4.0, ODC-By, CC0 and GPL; project page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
